reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and it does most of what these 'co-workers' promise if I paste stuff in. Maybe I'd poke at the free plan, but I'm not adding another 59 to 99 euros a month on a pitch that doesn't show me what it does that my current setup can't.
objection: I already pay for ChatGPT, what does this add? And 100 credits a month means nothing to me until I know what one credit actually buys, so I can't tell if it runs out in a week.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it actually update our CRM and follow up leads from Gmail on its own during a demo with our data, so it saves me hours ChatGPT can't, with a clear idea of how far the credits go.
